description:
MaskID protects your identity by hiding and masking personal data in any document before sharing. Easily process PDFs, photos, screenshots, forms, and files: cover only the sensitive information you choose, review every page, and export a safe, protected copy.

PROTECT & MASK ANY FILE
• Import PDFs, photos, screenshots, or images from your photo library and Files, or scan directly with the built-in document camera.
• Hide and mask personal data: IDs, passports, bank accounts (IBAN), signatures, addresses, payslips, and private details.
• On-device text recognition suggests sensitive info to review privately. You maintain complete control over what areas to cover.
• Multi-page document support to review and redact every page before export.

CHECK & VERIFY YOUR COPY
• Choose your redaction style (solid black, blur, pixelate, or outline) and adjust each mask manually.
• Export protected PDFs or images with permanent pixel flattening so hidden data cannot be recovered.
• Verify that no hidden text or common metadata remains before sharing via email, messaging, or web uploads.

ENCRYPTED VAULT & PRIVACY FIRST
• Built-in Vault protected by Face ID or PIN keeps your most sensitive files isolated and encrypted only on your device.
• Core protection works without creating an account or signing up.
• Optional private sync uses your personal iCloud via CloudKit.

ACCESS AND PURCHASES
New users can activate 15 calendar days of full access. This internal access period is not an App Store trial and does not start a purchase or automatic renewal. Free users from before this change receive 30 days of full access and 30 additional days to view, export, or delete their documents. After temporary access ends, a paid plan is required for commercial features. Your documents are not deleted when access expires.

MaskID Pro is available as monthly and annual subscriptions, with an optional one-time lifetime purchase. Apple shows the current price, duration, and renewal terms before you confirm. Restore eligible purchases in MaskID.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

whatsNew:
Faster, smoother, and more secure Vault access: Face ID and PIN now unlock instantly with no flickering.

WHAT'S NEW & IMPROVEMENTS
• Upgraded Vault: Instant unlock with Face ID or PIN, a direct button to lock whenever you want, and automatic locking when leaving the tab, locking your screen, or after 1 minute of inactivity.
• Protected Thumbnails: Preview your recent documents with their actual redactions applied. Vaulted documents stay securely blurred until you unlock them.
• Prominent Tab: Clearer, faster access to your encrypted Vault directly from the main navigation bar.
• Smoother Experience: Eliminated momentary screen flickers upon biometric authentication and refined on-device security transitions.
